explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the only true God, whose will must be followed to avoid sin and wrath.
The concept of God's grace through Jesus Christ that saves believers from the punishment of sin and grants eternal life.
An action or attitude that breaks God's laws, often associated with idolatry, adultery, or provoking the Lord.
False gods or things placed above God in people's hearts, which Paul warns against in this chapter.
The historical events from Israel's time in the wilderness that serve as a warning and lesson for Christians today.
God's undeserved favor and goodwill toward people, even when they deserve punishment due to sin.
Actions or attitudes that challenge God's patience and can lead to His wrath.
Temptation or enticement to do something wrong, but God always provides a way out so that one can stand firm.
The human body which is the temple of the Holy Spirit and should be used for God's glory.
The way Christians gather to eat bread and drink wine in remembrance of Jesus' death, something that requires cleansing from sin.
